Subject: Pilot kickoff & counsel items — checking procurement priority

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Quick recap from our discovery and the agreed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Scope: 2-week pilot (ingest + retrieval) integrated with your payments dataset; low-latency inference requirement for routing events under 150ms p95.
- Success metrics: <10% false positives on anomaly reranking, under $0.02/token cost target for 128-token average responses.
- Next steps from Redwood: share SOW + contract redlines to counsel, provide SOC2 artifacts and a short runbook for deployment.

I've attached the SOW and our recommended contract redlines (Redwood_Redlines_v3.docx, SOW_Pilot_3.pdf). I shared the redlines with your counsel last Friday but attaching again to make it easy for procurement. Can you confirm:

1) Whether procurement/counsel have any blockers we should be aware of (data retention, indemnity, export controls)?
2) If the pilot is still a priority for FinLedger for a Jan 10–14 kickoff window?

If counsel prefers to mark up the doc directly, I'm happy to take a quick call with your lawyer to walk through the two non-standard asks (prefix cache retention clause & limited indemnity language) so we can shorten their review cycle.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call this week if that helps — availability currently Thu 11/2 10:00–11:30 or Fri 11/3 14:00–16:00 PT.

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0127

Thanks Lukas — appreciate the clear recap.

We received the redlines and SOW. Counsel has started an initial pass and flagged two items that will need business sign-off: data retention window (they want a shorter minimum retention for logs) and an indemnity carve-out for a third-party payments provider. I've looped Francis (procurement) on this thread so he can coordinate the commercial review and get us an ETA.

Tentative: counsel expects to have annotated redlines by end of next week (12/10) — Francis will let us know if they need any additional artifacts from Redwood (SOC2, DPA, or export-control statements). Pilot window is still something we want to hit in January, but will depend on how quick counsel/procurement move.

I'll follow up once I have Francis's confirmation.

Best,
Claire O'Neill
